verdict.rationale: Evidence shows native integrations (auditor-vetted) and an MCP server for AI assistants to work within Thoropass, plus evidence request comment/attachment features, but there is no documented public REST/API for developers to build custom integrations that push evidence or test results from unsupported systems. Missing for 10: a documented developer API/SDK, authentication/API-key setup, and endpoints for submitting evidence/test results programmatically.
